description: Deploys the files and returns the app's URL. With a connected fuast account it creates a new private app in the person's workspace, or updates the app named in app. Without an account it deploys a temporary preview and returns preview_url, claim_url and edit_token: give the person claim_url so they can make the app theirs, and pass edit_token to later calls to keep working on it. Send every file each time; use update_app_files to change a few. A failed build returns diagnostics with file and line and deploys nothing.

app.description: Slug of an existing app in the connected account to update. Leave out to create a new app.

delete_tables.description: Only when a deploy was refused because the new schema drops tables that hold rows: repeat each table with the exact row count from that error to confirm deleting it.

edit_token.description: To update a preview that was deployed without an account: the edit_token that deploy returned.

files.description: The whole app as {"relative/path": "file content"}. server/index.ts and client/index.tsx are required. Text files only (.ts .tsx .js .jsx .mjs .json .md .svg .txt .css .html).

name.description: Name of a new app. Its address is derived from it. Ignored when updating an app.

name: deploy_app
title: Deploy an app
